propositions: when the epic-close bug screen's LLM provider calls raise LLMUnavailableError (e.g. Bedrock ValidationException), the broad per-candidate exception handler degrades each failure to verdict C ('unrelated') instead of propagating the error, silently blinding the caused_by bug floor

a systematic provider failure that affects all or most candidate evaluations produces a PASS verdict with no aggregate signal (unevaluated count, attestation withhold, or close block), making the safety check disappear exactly when its dependency is misconfigured

the completion verifier must propagate LLMUnavailableError (including subclass LLMConfigError) from all call sites within the epic-close bug screen instead of degrading, so the close gate's fail-closed handler blocks the close with a clear provider-error signal, consistent with the absent-provider path

non-systemic per-candidate failures (malformed output, store glitches, non-LLMUnavailableError exceptions) must continue to degrade to C to preserve documented degrade-open behavior for advisory-screen failures
the max_tokens re-clamp defect (request ceiling not re-evaluated when model shrinks from 128K to 64K, causing Bedrock 400) was fixed separately in commit e49e7a418a and is merged on main
the --force-close escape hatch must remain functional to allow operators to bypass the completion verifier block when needed
